note: unseenpark (docs/243 D1, §9), NOT RUN, retargeted 2026-11-13 to master 411ace46 package (same package both arms: kUnseenPark False, --ab unseenpark flips it at runtime, ShortcutOn). Timing = one 20-min in-load A/B per world (slice 2 = 10 alternating 2-min slices, off first); read per-arm ms/s with arm-ms.ts: continue only at >= 5 ms/s on BP and IP; under that, hold (one fix round, then park). Household exemption: UnseenFallback.cs:137 (IsSelectable or ActiveHousehold = kHousehold, never unseen, so ParkVerdict never holds); a classifier exception returns -1 = not unseen. Stop if searches fall under ~15% or a routing bar FAILs (R1-R6 docs/246 §6). Correctness jobs run with unseenpark ON via fixesOn; check also compares autonomy search counts per Sim-hour via unseen_park_ counters. Dropped from the 11-06 draft: onfirst reruns (in-load alternation balances order) and focus/arrive repros (need the gate2 stack and the -live package).
